evals.name: feature-project-scope
evals.prompt: Add a project scope. When g:waypoint_scope is 'project', waypoints belong to the project of the current file: the nearest folder above it that holds one of g:waypoint_root_markers, which defaults to ['.git']. The default, 'global', keeps today's behavior, and a file with no project root uses the global waypoints. Design it first in a new `## Feature: <name>` section of docs/DESIGN.md, with subsections for commands and settings, data changes, files touched, and tests. Then implement it, test it, and update doc/waypoint.txt and README.md.
